long.title: San Francisco Chillhop 🚆
long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated San Francisco on a fresh spring morning: the Golden Gate Bridge rising out of the fog, the Transamerica Pyramid and Coit Tower over the bay, cable cars, and pastel Victorian houses with poppies and lavender out front, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.summary: The Golden Gate Bridge rising out of soft morning fog, then a ride past pastel Victorian houses and the San Francisco skyline, with mellow lofi beats.
